authorization_note: For the current B4 training-system validation campaign, remove Amharic completely and defer any smaller language that still prevents progress without weakening a gate. After Acholi was deferred, the fresh 11-language 1e-4 confirmation failed closed only on Fula termination (3 of 51 rows without EOS). The owner explicitly approved deferring Fula and raising the cumulative B4 ceiling to $12. Oromo and Luganda remain active.
interpretation: Removal is a reversible experiment-scope deferral. No registry entry, manifest, audio object, transcript, prior evidence, model artifact or historical MLflow record is deleted or rewritten.

training_mix_binding.governance_rebind_note: The source corpus and 19-row policy remain byte-identical. A new immutable adoption key and a new scoped fingerprint make the Fula deferral explicit without overwriting any earlier scope or adoption.

immutable_scope_evidence.use: scope diagnosis and base-arm reuse analysis only; no adapter is authorised for reuse because every prior adapter was trained on a superseded language mix

acholi.reason: With the corrected 600-step scheduler horizon, 1e-4 is the only arm that passes every unchanged hard gate for the other six retained validation languages. Acholi alone fails termination in that arm: one of 65 rows hits the generation cap.

oromo.reason: All three corrected scheduler-horizon arms terminate fully and improve WER.

ewe.reason: Ewe remains outside the campaign under revision 2 evidence; no gate was weakened and no new Ewe data was evaluated in the corrected scoped attempt.

luganda.reason: The corrected 1e-4 arm terminates fully and improves WER. Failures at higher learning rates do not block the predeclared viable lower-rate continuation.

fula.reason: The fresh 11-language 1e-4 confirmation failed the unchanged termination gate only on Fula: 3 of 51 rows exhausted all 440 generated tokens without EOS. The same rows terminated in the base arm, so this is a learned candidate regression rather than a malformed or oversized validation row.

retained_scope_evidence.interpretation: The fresh attempt-1 result supports 1e-4 for the five retained validation languages, all of which passed the unchanged WER and termination gates. It cannot supply final weights because it was trained on the superseded 11-language mix; the 10-language mix requires fresh training.
